title: Total Quality Management: Main Exam, 13 August 2018
department: Department of Information Technology / enterprise Computing
instructions: ANSWER ALL QUESTIONS IN SECTION A AND ANY OTHER TWO FROM SECTION B.

parts.text: Outline the dimensions of quality in both the production and service sectors.
What are the barriers to TQM implementation? How are they eliminated?
Define quality for the following products using the principles of TQM.
Software quality is defined as conformance to explicitly stated functional and non-functional requirements. Explain the software quality factors.
Quality management is currently cutting across other areas of management in several organizations. Discuss the relationship between quality management and other management disciplines.
Discuss the merits and demerits of business process re-engineering (BPR).
Discuss the skills to develop in a Six Sigma organization.
Customer satisfaction is determined by a number of issues. Explain the determinants of customer satisfaction.
One of the principles that guide the success of total quality management is process improvement. Explain tools that can be used for process improvement.
Customer focus is an organization's orientation towards satisfying the needs of potential and actual customers. Discuss the goals of customer focus.
Explain the various types of software testing that can be used to assure stakeholders of software quality.
